test_title: PYST 37: SSC GD Constable 2025 - English (Held On: 21 Feb, 2025 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Fungi are tiny organisms found everywhere—in nature, in our homes and even in and on _______ bodies.
solution:
The correct answer is '**our**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
__ 
 
• The blank in the sentence refers to "bodies" that include humans collectively. Hence, the possessive pronoun **"our"** is appropriate. 
 
• Options **1 ("their")**, **3 ("your")**, and **4 ("my")** do not fit the context because the sentence is talking about humans in general. 
 
• **Option 2 ("our")** correctly indicates collective ownership of the bodies being referred to. 
 
Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**. 
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"Fungi are tiny organisms found everywhere—in nature, in our homes and even in and on **our**__ bodies."* 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 
 
 
• **Option 1 ("their"):** Incorrect because "their" implies ownership by another group, which does not match the context of the sentence. 
 
• **Option 3 ("your"):** Incorrect because "your" refers to the person being spoken to, which does not fit the general statement. 
 
• **Option 4 ("my"):** Incorrect because "my" refers to the speaker's own body, which limits the general scope of the sentence.
